title: Shadcn-like Configuration Schema
description: Schema for validating a configuration file that dictates component installation and configuration.

components.description: An array of components that are available for installation.

name.description: The unique name of the component (e.g., 'button', 'card').

style.description: The designated style for this component (e.g., 'default', 'new-york').

path.description: The relative path to the component's source file.

config.description: Global configuration settings for the CLI or application.

tailwind.description: Settings related to Tailwind CSS configuration.

css.description: Path to the global CSS file.

rootDir.description: The root directory where components should be placed (e.g., 'src/components').

alias.description: The module alias used for component imports (e.g., '@/components').
